title: Aadhaar Free Document Update Deadline Extended
summary: UIDAI has extended the free online document update facility up to September 14, 2026. Citizens can upload identity and address proofs for free.

title: ITR Filing Deadline for AY 2026-27 is July 31, 2026
summary: The last date to file Income Tax Returns (ITR) for individual taxpayers for Assessment Year 2026-27 is July 31, 2026. Avoid late filing fee by filing early.

title: TTD Rs 300 Special Entry Darshan Tickets Release
summary: Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD) will release Special Entry Darshan (SED) tickets quota for August 2026 on June 24 at 10:00 AM.

title: KPSC Gazetted Probationers Recruitment Notification 2026
summary: KPSC has released the recruitment notification for Gazetted Probationers (Group A & B) posts. Online applications are open from June 20 to July 20, 2026.

title: SSP Post-Matric Scholarship Deadline Approaching
summary: State Scholarship Portal (SSP) post-matric scholarship applications for SC/ST/OBC students will close on June 30, 2026. Submit documents urgently.

title: PM-Kisan 18th Instalment Release Status Update
summary: The 18th instalment of PM-Kisan scheme is expected to be released directly into farmers bank accounts in July. Ensure e-KYC is completed.

title: Seva Sindhu Portal Scheduled Maintenance Downtime
summary: The Seva Sindhu portal will undergo scheduled database maintenance and will be temporarily offline from June 20 at 10:00 PM to June 21 at 6:00 AM.

title: Ooty E-Pass Mandatory for Tourists till June 30, 2026
summary: As per Madras HC orders, tourist e-pass is mandatory to enter Nilgiris (Ooty) and Kodaikanal districts for all outstation vehicles until June 30, 2026.

title: BESCOM Scheduled Power Interruptions in Mandya District
summary: BESCOM announces power cuts in parts of Mandya and Maddur taluk on June 22, 2026, from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM due to substation line upgrades.

title: Ayushman Bharat Card Registration Drive in Grama Panchayats
summary: A mega registration drive for Ayushman Bharat Health Cards (ABHA) is being conducted across all grama panchayats in Mandya district this week.

title: Bhoomi RTC Mutation Application Processing Fee Revision
summary: Revenue department has issued a circular revising the Bhoomi mutation application fee at Nada Kacheris. The new rate is applicable from July 1, 2026.

title: Sabarimala Monthly Pooja Darshan Opening Dates
summary: Sabarimala temple will open for monthly poojas for Malayalam month Karkidakam from July 16 to July 21. Virtual Q bookings are now open.

title: Bandipur Tiger Reserve Wildlife Safari Timing Advisory
summary: Forest department has issued a travel advisory regarding changes in safari slot timings during the summer season. Evening safaris will start 30 mins late.

title: General Administration Department Public Holiday Declaration
summary: Karnataka Government has declared a local public holiday in the district on the occasion of the annual regional festival.
